name: Media Library Widget Texts
description: Make Media Library widget texts configurable.
project_description:
The Media Library Widget Texts module adds the option to overwrite the texts used in the media library widget. This makes it possible, among other things, to change the text on the “Add media” button to “Add image,” for example.
